plan.name: traffic_light_pedestrian

states.purpose: normal green phase for vehicles; pedestrians wait
red phase for vehicles; may be followed by pedestrian phase

plan.summary: The machine starts in vehicle_green. Normal cycling proceeds green->yellow->red->green with short timers. If a pedestrian presses the button during green, yellow, or red, a flag (ped_requested) is set. Upon entering vehicle_red, if ped_requested is true the machine transitions to pedestrian_walk instead of returning to green, then proceeds through pedestrian_clear and back to green. All timing is handled via delayed internal timer events. Output signals (signal.green, signal.yellow, signal.red, signal.ped_walk, signal.ped_clear) are sent to the invoker on state entry.

transitions.description: green phase expired; advance to yellow
pedestrian pressed button during green; set flag
yellow phase expired; advance to red
red phase expired with no pedestrian request; return to green
red phase expired with pedestrian request; enter walk
pedestrian pressed button during red; set flag
walk phase expired; enter clear countdown
clear phase expired; return to green
